required_content_conditions: content_class compatible with requested media role
orientation/aspect can satisfy target placement without destructive crop
people count/type compatible with scene intent
evidence boundary compatible with surrounding copy

anti_repetition_policy.goal: permit economically efficient reuse without producing skin-swap/template resemblance
hard_rules: the same exact binary cannot occupy multiple dominant roles within one LP
within the same generation batch, hero/dominant assets must be unique across companies unless HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED explicitly approves an exception
the same asset must not repeat with the same role + same crop fingerprint across adjacent/current production outputs
a company may not inherit another company's full media-role sequence as an asset bundle
reuse history is a ranking penalty, never a reason to switch Creative Family/topology
generic stock reuse must be visually redistributed through different role, crop, scale, composition, or omitted rather than forcing a repeated asset bundle
anti_repetition_policy.threshold_policy: Do not invent a global numeric Template Resemblance threshold in this contract. Persist reuse metrics now; calibrate numeric limits from observed production batches and Aoi reviews.

renderer_may: choose among pre-approved responsive crop variants
renderer_must_not: crop out rights/attribution markings when required
turn generic context into apparent company evidence
